text:
maria_cs: Quick sync — cohort-7 onboarding + renewal-risk triage. Three customers stuck on data-plane onboarding: Kestrel (waiting for SAML + IP allowlist), Nimbus (quota/limits), LatticeHealth (VPN handshake). Need owners and 2-week enablement windows. Can owners volunteer? cc @sam_ops @jie_pm :spiral_calendar:

sam_ops: I can take Kestrel. ETA for enablement session: Wed 3/24 10–11 PT. Need SAML metadata and a contact. @maria_cs can you DM the SP metadata? :+1:

jie_pm: I'll own Nimbus. Is there a soft cutoff for sandbox access? Customer said they may revert if tokens spike. Propose 2w trial with cost monitoring, weekly check-ins.

oliver_eng: For LatticeHealth VPN issue — we're seeing an MTU mismatch. Temp workaround: set enable_large_packets: false in private agent config. Example:
```yaml
agent:
  network:
    enable_large_packets: false
```
Will push a patched image later today.

maria_cs: awesome. @sam_ops add onboarding checklist below and paste invite links. @jie_pm schedule weekly check w/ stakeholders. I'll reach out to account managers for renewal risk flags.

sam_ops: onboarding checklist:
```- pre-call: confirm SAML metadata / VPN creds
- day0: onboarding runbook + quickstarts
- day1: smoke tests (kv cache, token limits)
- week1: perf baseline + cost alert
- week2: handoff + renewal health review
```
Invite: https://cal.com/sam_ops/30?slot=cohort7

jie_pm: added Nimbus weekly check on 3/26 9am ET. I'll bring cost dashboard + canary prompts.

maria_cs: deploy-bot kicked off auto-reminder to participants for 3 onboarding slots :robot_face: 

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: cohort-7 onboarding reminders -> 3 slots over next 10 days.

maria_cs: Owners: Kestrel -> sam_ops, Nimbus -> jie_pm, LatticeHealth -> oliver_eng. Next sync Friday 3/27 4pm PT. I'll drop a short NPS micro-survey after week2. Anything else?

sam_ops: all good from my side. I'll DM SAML metadata now.

jie_pm: good.

oliver_eng: will push patch + update runbook by EOD.
